name: smol-media-processor
description: Bounded Bun/Elysia helper for versioned multi-output image recipes and explicit video normalization.
author: Levi Laine <levi.laine.me@gmail.com>

scripts.fmt: prettier --write src scripts contracts .github/workflows package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md

scripts.check: bun run contracts:check && bun run fmt:check && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
